name: Odd One Out
hint: Check your badge: some jobs only you can do.
why4: Only P4 can reach the plate that opens the slot, the 4-high ledge needs two friends under the climber, and only P3 can pass the mint gate to the button.
solution: P4 walks onto the gold floor at x=9-10, drops through it into the cellar below and stands on the plate there: tall gate A at x=16 opens.
P2 and P1 hop over P3 (the climber goes last) and walk into the slot at x=17-19. P2 stands against the ledge at x=19; P1 jumps onto P2's head.

P3 jumps onto P1's head, then up onto the ledge (height 4), walks right through the mint gate at x=23, touches the key at x=26 and the button at x=28 (toggle: gates A and E open and stay open), hops the button and drops off the ledge's right end.
P4 jumps out of the cellar (2 up); P1 hops down; P1, P2, P4 walk through the tunnel under the ledge (mouth at x=20) to x=31+.
Everyone jumps the 2-wide pit at x=35-36; P3 opens the door at x=42; all press Down.
